about: Plain-language requests for scripts/eval_llm.py. The 25 dataset raw_text cases are built from cit_public.json by the script; these are the public samples plus our own tricky set. 'expect' keys: attendance, duration, windows [[day, from, to]], days (all days incl. repeats), needs_include, room_types_include, room (requested_room, null = none), groups, category, follow_up (true = must ask, false = must not), follow_up_mentions, notes_mention.
